summary: Round 2 regression: verified Mark Settled bug fix (logic + UI overflow), per-worker PDF, worker Advance Return, contractor Return, contractor PDF/Excel, and Ad carousel hold-to-pause + swipe + autoplay. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed. Frontend: full E2E via OTP → profile → workers → attendance → ledger settle → contractors covered, all assertions passed on 420x900 viewport.

issues: Console warning: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning, not blocker)

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to shadcn Dialogs to silence a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1200 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth, contractors, reports, ledger).
compute_worker_ledger sums total_settled into net_advance to zero pending - correct math but implicit; add a docstring/unit test to prevent regression.
OTP send returns dev_otp in response (fine for dev), ensure this is gated behind env flag before production.
test_credentials: Uses ephemeral OTP flow; each test run creates a new user via /api/auth/otp/send + /api/auth/otp/verify (dev_otp returned in response).
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates TEST_ prefixed workers/contractors/attendance/advances/returns/settlements/payments. Not cleaned up (dev DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers settlement=0 pending, worker return, per-worker PDF filename, contractor return/net_paid, contractor PDF+Excel, /ads. UI test flow: OTP -> profile-setup (Bengaluru Urban) -> /workers add worker -> /attendance click first Present -> /ledger row exercises Mark Settled (full-width, no truncation, pending -> ₹0) -> /workers (contractors section) add contractor -> detail shows contractor-pdf-btn/excel-btn and cpay-mode toggles. AdCarousel: hold-to-pause verified (Paused badge shows on mouse down, disappears on release), autoplay 10s, swipe advances.
rca of the issue: N/A - all previously-reported bug fixes verified as fixed. Mark Settled math: POST /settlements records max(0, pending) into settlements collection; compute_worker_ledger adds total_settled to net_advance so pending = earned - (advance - returned + settled) collapses to 0 on next GET /ledger/{worker_id}. UI: settle button uses col-span-2 (full width row 3 of 2-col grid) so no truncation on 420px viewport.
